original_bug_description: A NULL/uninitialized-pointer dereference (segmentation fault) in urshift (mrbgems/mruby-bigint/core/bigint.c). urshift does not correctly handle zero-valued mpz_t operands and can read from an invalid/garbage limb pointer when performing right-shift operations (observed via mpz_div_2exp -> mrb_bint_rshift). This leads to a crash (invalid memory read) and can be triggered by crafted inputs, causing denial-of-service or other undefined behavior in mruby.
